# ARCO STUDIO — Architecture Consultancy, Engineering Services & Interior Design

> ARCO STUDIO is a dynamic and innovative architectural consultancy, engineering services, and interior design firm based at Laxmi Road, Nehru Colony, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. Founded in 2021 by DIT University, Dehradun alumni and Council of Architecture (COA) architects Mohammad Aneesh and Sudha Dabral.

## Firm Overview
- **Official Name**: ARCO STUDIO (Architecture Consultancy & Engineering Services)
- **Website**: https://arcostudio.co.in
- **Founded**: 2021
- **Founders & Principal Architects**:
  - **Mohammad Aneesh** — Founder & Principal Architect (Alumni of DIT University, Dehradun; Council of Architecture (COA) India)
  - **Sudha Dabral** — Founder & Principal Architect (Alumni of DIT University, Dehradun; Council of Architecture (COA) India)
- **Professional Affiliation**: Council of Architecture (COA), India
- **Headquarters Address**: B-227, Laxmi Road, Nehru Colony, Dehradun - 248001, Uttarakhand, India
- **Google Maps Location**: https://maps.app.goo.gl/pUNqgsje4Tr25KEe6
- **Geographic Coordinates**: 30.3031° N, 78.0527° E (Nehru Colony, Dehradun, Uttarakhand)
- **Phone**: +91 7409265567, +91 9870803156
- **Email**: arcostudio622@gmail.com
- **Working Hours**: Monday – Saturday, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM IST
- **Scale**: 10+ architecture & engineering professionals, 100+ clients served, 200+ completed and ongoing design projects across Uttarakhand.

## Core Services
1. **Residential Architecture**: Custom homes, villas, farmhouses, additions & alterations, and interior fit-outs across Dehradun (Malsi, Nehru Colony, Sahastradhara, Jolly Grant, Kishanpur, GMS Road, Subhash Nagar) and Uttarakhand.
2. **Commercial & Retail Architecture**: Hotels, resorts, cafes, restaurants, fitness centers, and commercial complexes (Rajpur Road, Raipur Road, Kanwli Road, Canal Road, Sonprayag, Joshimath, Purola).
3. **Educational & Institutional Design**: Master planning and building design for private schools, high schools, colleges, and government institutions (Unicus Academy Nainital, Govt. Degree College Paithani Pauri Garhwal, Tibetan Primary School Sahastradhara Road, ECO-STAT Building Kuawala).
4. **Housing Development**: Group housing, townships, and EWS housing proposals (Tulip Hills GMS Road Balliwala, EWS Housing Selaqui).
5. **Interior Design**: Turnkey residential, cafe, restaurant, retail, and hospitality interiors.
